part: XLaserLab SUP29F-XH welding gun with attached wire feed

cloud.array: xyz_normals: native x,y,z,nx,ny,nz, float32; coordinates in mm

photos.export: Photos JPEG, original size, High quality; location and caption export disabled. Committed derivatives have no EXIF.

operator_observations: The supplied scan captures approximately one side of the gun with the wire feed attached.
Only a corner of the umbilical wrap is captured. Its initial size is essentially the full grip section.
The tip did not retain the scan coating well and is missing from the scan.

reconstruction.frame: alignment.json; X forward along the barrel, Y transverse, Z up; front housing face at X=0; reflection across Y=0
reconstruction.method: Shared axis fit to the stem and silver sleeve sets the midpoint. The broad housing-side plane fixes roll. Retained Y>=0 samples and normals are reflected. Housing and feeder are separately reconstructed by screened Poisson and closed with explicit end/face constraints. The observed bracket openings are cut through the feeder. Analytic solids reconstruct the barrel and missing end features.

limits: Fusion spacing and model-to-scan residuals do not establish absolute accuracy. Coating thickness and scanner calibration error are unmeasured.
Opposite-side details are reflected as requested; any actual side-specific features are not independently observed.
The photos estimate the nozzle, front grip face, released trigger and boot. The guide pose is the captured pose; the remaining flexible umbilical is outside the model.
No physical mount fit, load capacity or lifetime is established by this reference.
